biggest_catch: The $3 only pays if your referral actually earns $3 first — and the 10% is a cut of whatever they earn, so it is real but variable, never guaranteed income.
catches: You get nothing until your referral earns at least $3 — only then does the $3 referral bonus credit.
$3 bonus credits within 24 hours after the referral crosses the $3 threshold.
The 10% applies only to eligible earnings; signup bonuses, courtesy credits, WinIt codes, Daily Goal bonuses, MyGiftCardsPlus bonuses, and referral bonuses are excluded.
Ongoing 10% earnings are variable — they depend on how active your referrals are, so never count on a fixed income from them.
No cap on referral earnings, per official terms.
One account per person; referrals must sign up through your referral link.

steps: Share your InboxDollars referral link — your friend must sign up as a new member through it.
Your referral earns at least $3 from eligible activities (signup bonuses, courtesy credits, WinIt codes, Daily Goal bonuses, MyGiftCardsPlus bonuses, and referral bonuses do not count).
Your $3 referral bonus is credited within 24 hours after they cross the $3 threshold.
You keep earning 10% of their eligible earnings for as long as they stay active — no cap.
